# Own public TEST vectors

`public.json` contains public keys, identities, messages and signatures for the
explicitly corrected Xie equation study, at n=16 and n=32. They are generated by
`experiments.research.candidates.xie.public_vectors` with its clearly named
`DeterministicRandom` TEST seeds. They are not author/official known-answer
vectors or safe parameters. No private keys, GPV geometry or live entropy appear
in the file. System-random lifecycle instances use a separate probe and directory.

Regenerate from the repository in the prescribed WSL environment:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=src:. ~/miniconda3/envs/sage/bin/python -m experiments.research.candidates.xie.public_vectors
```

Public verification and strict snapshots require Python only. Generating fresh
keys or signatures requires Sage on the main thread. See the C3 delivery for the
source conflicts, explicit repairs, public forgery witnesses and remaining gaps.
